items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton goes viral after emotional moment with Peter Bonnington in Mexico
items.summaryEn: Footage of Lewis Hamilton greeting his former Mercedes race engineer Peter 'Bono' Bonnington at the Mexican Grand Prix went viral, drawing praise from Formula 1 fans.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿墨西哥站与前工程师彼得·邦宁顿的感人互动走红
F1车迷称赞汉密尔顿向前比赛工程师彼得·邦宁顿的真挚致意
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
七届冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛上向前梅赛德斯比赛工程师彼得·“博诺”·邦宁顿致意的视频走红后，F1车迷对此表示赞赏。
汉密尔顿在效力于布拉克利车队期间一直与邦宁顿合作，并在那里赢得了七个总冠军中的六个。在41岁的汉密尔顿于2025年离开梅赛德斯转投法拉利后，邦宁顿开始与汉密尔顿的继任者基米·安东内利合作。
这位意大利车手在F1的第二个赛季就在墨西哥大奖赛上赢得了他的首个总冠军头衔。汉密尔顿被拍到拥抱邦宁顿，祝贺他取得这一成就。
“这个周末的照片太棒了。领奖台上的三人组非常出色，”一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，指的是墨西哥大奖赛的领奖台。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道夺冠。从杆位发车的汉密尔顿和安东内利分别获得第二和第三名。
“刘易斯真是个非常有风度的人。很明显他仍然对那起事件感到非常难过，但他把这件事放在一边，去庆祝他那些值得庆祝的朋友们，”另一个人发帖说。
“说实话，汉密尔顿感觉还是更像梅赛德斯车手，只是换了身赛车服，”另一位车迷写道，还有人评论说：“博诺今天一定百感交集。为安东内利高兴，但他心里有一部分还是希望这是汉密尔顿的第八个冠军，不是吗……”
更多评论包括：“博诺本赛季也是大赢家。想象一下，你曾是有史以来最伟大的F1车手之一的工程师，然后又要回去当一名新秀的工程师。最终结果对他来说真的非常好。而且我认为，这种搭档关系正是基米能做到这一点的关键。如此年轻、初来乍到，我觉得幕后有一位经验丰富的人支持你，真的会有天壤之别。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton goes viral after emotional moment with Peter Bonnington in Mexico
Formula 1 fans have praised Lewis Hamilton for his heartfelt congratulations to former race engineer Peter Bonnington
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Formula 1 fans have praised seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton after footage of him congratulating his former Mercedes race engineer Peter 'Bono' Bonnington at the Mexican Grand Prix went viral.

Hamilton worked with Bonnington throughout his time at the Brackley outfit, where he secured six of his seven championships. After the 41-year-old left Mercedes to move to Ferrari in 2025, Bonnington started working with Hamilton's successor, Kimi Antonelli.

The Italian driver secured his maiden championship title at the Mexican Grand Prix in only his second season in F1. Hamilton was captured hugging Bonnington as he congratulated him on the achievement.

"The pictures from this weekend have been class. The podium trio was fantastic," one fan commented on Reddit, referring to the Mexican Grand Prix podium. Red Bull's Max Verstappen won at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Hamilton, who started from pole position, and Antonelli finished second and third, respectively.
"Lewis is just a very classy dude. It's obvious he's still very upset about the incident, but he's putting that aside to celebrate his friends who deserve the celebration," someone else posted.

"Hamilton still feels more like a Merc driver honestly, just in a different suit," another fan wrote, while someone else commented: "Bono must have felt bittersweet today. Happy for Antonelli but part of him did want it to be Hamilton's 8th, didn't he..."

Further comments included: "Bono has also been a big winner this season. Imagine being the engineer for perhaps the greatest F1 driver of all time, then having to go back to being the engineer for a rookie. It really turned out really well for him in the end. And I think this partnership was really what Kimi needed to pull this off. Being so young and new to the scene, I think having a seasoned head behind the scenes supporting you really makes a world of difference."

items.originalTitle: George Russell breaks silence with heartfelt message after Kimi Antonelli's F1 title win
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在基米·安东内利F1冠军赛后发表感人信息
乔治·拉塞尔在社交媒体上对粉丝分享感人信息，反思了他艰难的2026赛季
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯
乔治·拉塞尔在墨西哥大奖赛后缺席媒体活动
这位英国车手在他的社交媒体上向粉丝发表了一篇长文，承认“2026年本不该是我的年份”，这是在他梅赛德斯车队的队友基米·安东内利在阿特奥多莫·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道赢得首个车手总冠军之后。
拉塞尔以夺冠热门的身份进入了2026赛季。但在他赢得赛季揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛和中国短道赛之后，他眼睁睁地看着安东内利在日本站领跑积分榜，并在车手总冠军中不断扩大领先优势。
这位28岁的车手缺席了赛后媒体见面会，这似乎促使他向粉丝发表了一则信息。他在文中写道：“现在感觉是一个从心底说话的合适时机。”
“这个赛季一开始就正如我所希望的那样，但很快因为不幸和糟糕的表现而变得支离破碎。这是我职业生涯中第一个真正意义上的赛季，我的坏日子比好日子多。”
“我所知道的就是我已经全力以赴了，2026年并不是我的年份。我衷心祝贺基米，他的赛季绝对令人难以置信。你真正值得这个冠军。”
“感谢车队制造出本赛季最好的赛车和动力单元；看到大家在这四年的艰难中团结一致，把梅赛德斯带回顶峰，这令人鼓舞。”
“现在，我所能承诺的就是，在这个赛季的剩余时间和下一个赛季，我会全力以赴，重新找回我在职业生涯的大部分时间里能够产生的表现，并希望一点运气也能回来。谢谢大家。”
“拉塞尔仍然在为车手锦标赛的第二名而战。尽管他在墨西哥的第六名成绩让他从第二名降至第四名，但第二名维斯塔潘和第五名勒克莱尔之间只有16分。”
detailEn: George Russell breaks silence with heartfelt message after Kimi Antonelli's F1 title win
George Russell has reflected on his difficult 2026 Formula 1 season in a heartfelt message to fans
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
George Russell has shared a heartfelt message after missing media duties following the Mexican Grand Prix.

The Briton admitted that "2026 was not meant to be my year" in a long message to his fans on social media after his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli claimed his maiden championship at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez.

Russell entered the 2026 season as a clear favourite to win the title. But after he won the season-opening Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race, he watched on as Antonelli took the lead of the standings in Japan and continued to extend his advantage in the championship.
The 28-year-old's absence from the post-race media sessions appears to have prompted a message to his fans. "Now feels like a pretty suitable moment to speak from the heart," he wrote.

"This season started off exactly how I had hoped but it very quickly unravelled with tough luck and poor performances. It’s been the first proper season of my career where I’ve had more bad days than good.

"All I know is that I’ve given it my all and 2026 was not meant to be my year. I want to sincerely congratulate Kimi on what has been an absolutely incredible season. You truly deserve the championship.
"Thank you to the team for producing the best car and power unit this season; it’s been inspiring to see everyone coming together over four tough years to bring Mercedes back to the top.

"Now, all I can promise is that for the rest of this season, and into the next one, I will be giving my absolute all to rediscover the performance I have been capable of producing for the majority of my career and fingers crossed a little bit of luck returns. Thanks all."

Russell is still in the fight for second in the drivers' championship. While his sixth-place finish in Mexico dropped him from second to fourth, there are still only 16 points between Max Verstappen in second and Charles Leclerc in fifth.

items.originalTitle: Russell posts statement to 'speak from the heart'
items.summaryEn: After Kimi Antonelli secured the F1 Drivers' Championship at the Mexico City Grand Prix, his Mercedes team-mate George Russell posted a statement on social media on Monday saying he wanted to "speak from the heart".
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔：这位梅赛德斯车手在墨西哥城大奖赛上、基米·安东内利加冕世界冠军后，发布声明表示要“说出心里话”。
梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔在周一的社交媒体上发文，此前他在周日的墨西哥城大奖赛赛后没有接受媒体采访，那场比赛中他的队友基米·安东内利成为世界冠军；周五圣保罗大奖赛的各节练习将于下午3点30分和晚上7点在天空体育F1直播。
马丁·布伦德尔认为，基米·安东内利赢得世界冠军可能会激发乔治·拉塞尔的“超常状态”，或者对这位梅赛德斯队友来说意味着“一切结束”。
乔治·拉塞尔在社交媒体上发布声明，表示要“说出心里话”，此前他的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利在周日锁定了F1车手总冠军。
梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫透露，拉塞尔在墨西哥站“极度沮丧”，并在祝贺安东内利成为世界冠军后直接回家了。
国际汽联对梅赛德斯处以5000欧元（4173英镑）的罚款，原因是拉塞尔在赛后缺席了强制性的媒体职责，但这位英国车手已于周一首次公开发表了自己的评论。

“现在感觉是一个相当合适的时机，来说说心里话，”他在Instagram上写道。
“这个赛季的开局完全如我所愿，但很快就被坏运气和糟糕的表现打乱了。
“这是我职业生涯中第一个真正意义上坏日子多于好日子的赛季。应对起来难吗？是的，非常难。每周都要重新振作起来难吗？是的，非常难。有时会感到困惑吗？经常。我只知道我已经倾尽全力，而2026年注定不属于我。”
拉塞尔上周表示，随着这位梅赛德斯车手将注意力转向明年挑战世界冠军，他希望自己能够更加稳定。
拉塞尔赛季初是明显的夺冠热门，但被安东内利全面压制，后者在还剩四轮的情况下以20岁之龄成为F1史上最年轻的世界冠军。
安东内利赢下九场比赛，而拉塞尔只有三胜；后者在墨西哥城大奖赛首圈因动力单元问题导致动力不足后，车手积分榜已跌至第四。
拉塞尔继续说道：“我想真诚地祝贺基米度过了一个绝对不可思议的赛季。你完全配得上这个冠军。”
基米·安东内利夺冠时刻在意大利语解说中的声音是怎样的
“感谢车队打造了本赛季最好的赛车和动力单元；看到大家在艰难的四年里齐心协力，让梅赛德斯重返巅峰，这令人备受鼓舞。”
“现在，我能承诺的是，在本赛季剩余时间以及下个赛季，我将竭尽全力，重新找回我职业生涯大部分时间所能展现的表现，并祈祷能找回一点运气。”
“感谢所有的支持。”

items.originalTitle: Peter Bonnington reveals "stern conversation" that transformed Kimi Antonelli's F1 career
detailZh: 彼得·博宁顿透露 "严肃的对话" 改变了基米·安东内利的F1生涯
基米·安东内利的赛车工程师彼得·博宁顿揭示了如何一次严肃的对话帮助这位意大利车手克服了艰难的新秀赛季
彼得·博宁顿，赛车工程师，梅赛德斯
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说。有关银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和赛事分析
基米·安东内利的赛车工程师彼得'Bono'邦宁顿透露，一场'非常严肃的谈话'帮助这位意大利车手扭转了他在一年前的新秀一级方程式赛季，那一年他成为了2026年的世界冠军。
安东内利在上周末的墨西哥大奖赛中获得了第三名，这足以确保他获得首个冠军头衔。在比赛后接受F1电视采访时，邦宁顿回顾了安东内利如何克服了2025年在梅赛德斯车队艰难的首个赛季，并在2026年占据主导地位。
‘那是我们真正受益的令人惊叹的事情或经历之一，因为事实是，你从你的糟糕日子里学习，这正是他擅长做的事情，就是学习，’邦宁顿在谈到安东内利在2025年欧洲赛季中的困难时期时解释道。
‘我们在欧洲赛季结束时进行了一场非常严肃的谈话。然后我们又进入了飞越赛段，突然间他就像说，‘你为什么没有早点给我一个屁股踢？’是的，那是一段艰难的时光，但是什么让你活下去，就让你变得更强大，他确实从那些困难中反弹回来。’
尽管他的队友乔治·拉塞尔在2026赛季被视为夺冠热门，安东内利在第三轮赛事中，凭借在中日大奖赛连续夺冠，成功领跑车手积分榜。
尽管许多人认为压力会压垮他，这位20岁的年轻人却越战越勇。本赛季他已赢得了九场大奖赛。
曾与七次世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿和迈克尔·舒马赫共事的邦宁顿表示，管理车手是他工作的一部分，就像管理赛车一样。
“人们以前常说，尤其是以前，‘你们为什么没有让体育心理学家与车手一起工作？’而你可能会想，嗯，那不正是赛车工程师的工作吗。工作的一半是照顾赛车，另一半是让车手保持开心。”
“是啊，他是个很容易让人高兴的人。和他一起工作是一种乐趣，同时也要引导他度过其中的起伏，尤其是去年。这只是工作的一部分。有些人在这方面比其他人做得更好。”
detailEn: Peter Bonnington reveals "stern conversation" that transformed Kimi Antonelli's F1 career
Kimi Antonelli's race engineer Peter Bonnington has revealed how a stern conversation helped the Italian overcome a difficult rookie season
Peter Bonnington, Race Engineer, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Kimi Antonelli's race engineer Peter 'Bono' Bonnington has revealed that a "really stern conversation" helped turn around the Italian driver's rookie Formula 1 season, a year before he became the 2026 world champion.

Antonelli finished third at last weekend's Mexican Grand Prix, which was enough to secure his maiden title. While speaking to F1 TV after the race, Bonnington reflected on how Antonelli overcame a challenging debut season with Mercedes in 2025 to dominate in 2026.

"That’s one of the amazing things or amazing experiences that we actually benefited from, because the fact is that you learn from your bad days and that’s what he’s really good at doing, is just learning," Bonnington explained of Antonelli's difficult spell during the European season in 2025.

"We had a really stern conversation at the end of the European season. And then we got into the flyaways again and all of a sudden he was just like, ‘Why didn’t you give me a kick up the arse sooner?’ And so, yeah, it was tough times, but what doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, and he really did bounce back from those."

While his team-mate George Russell entered the 2026 season as a clear favourite for the title, Antonelli took the lead of the championship at the third round after back-to-back wins at the Chinese and Japanese Grands Prix.
Despite many assuming the title pressure would get the better of him, the 20-year-old went from strength to strength. He has won nine grands prix so far this season.
Bonnington, who has previously worked with seven-time champions Lewis Hamilton and Michael Schumacher, said managing a driver was as much a part of his role as managing the car.

"People have said before, especially back in the day, 'Why don’t you have a sports psychologist working with drivers?' and you’re like, well, that’s kind of what the race engineer has to do. Half of the job is looking after the car, the other half is keeping the driver happy.

"So yeah, he’s an easy guy to keep happy. It’s a pleasure working with him, but also guiding him through the ups and downs of it, especially last year. It’s just part of the job. Some are better at it than others."
